exposure: Doppler parameters of umbilical artery (UA) and middle cerebral artery (MCA)
middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
outcome: mode of delivery (cesarean delivery, operative vaginal delivery)
neonatal outcome (umbilical artery blood pH, NICU admission)
cohort: 97 patients with singleton small-for-gestational-age (SGA) fetuses at term (≥ 37 + 0 weeks' gestation)
finding: In SGA fetuses at term, higher UA PI was associated with an increased rate of cesarean delivery, and both higher UA PI and lower MCA PI and CPR were associated with an increased need for NICU admission.
